title: Kim Jong Un calls for ‘most destructive’ artillery capability

blocks.text: North Korean leader Kim Jong-un called for his country’s artillery forces to have the “most concentrated and destructive” capabilities as he visited major munitions factories earlier this week, state media reported Saturday.
